about: Which paths the engine reads as absolute (README.md, Conventions): `win32` for an engine on Windows, `posix` for one on Linux or macOS. Every path in a job must be absolute for the engine that runs it, so a client that writes jobs checks its own rule against each case here.

cases.what: a drive and its root, with forward slashes
a UNC share with forward slashes; on Linux and macOS, a root name and a root
a drive and its root after the \\?\ prefix
a UNC server without a root
a root name without a root
from the root of the current drive
from the root; on Windows, of the current drive
from the root, with more than one slash; on Windows, of the current drive
a drive without its root: relative to that drive's current folder
